behavior_constraints: All endpoints enforce a default 10 MB request body size limit.
The /api/v1/models/{id}/versions endpoint enforces the configured max_model_size_mb limit instead of the 10 MB default.
Requests exceeding the applicable limit receive HTTP 413.
Requests within the configured limits continue to work with existing behavior and response shapes.
Only Go standard library packages are used for the body-limiting implementation.
entities.summary: This round demands request body size limiting with a 10 MB default for all endpoints and configured max_model_size_mb for model version uploads, returning HTTP 413 when exceeded.

instruction_head:
## Security Review: No Request Body Size Limits

There are no request body size limits anywhere in the gateway. An attacker can send an arbitrarily large POST body (e.g. 100 GB) to any endpoint, exhausting memory and causing a denial-of-service.

### Required Fix
